terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: Terreno example API on http://localhost:4000 (health at /health, OpenAPI at /openapi.json).
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; MONGO_URI="mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/terreno-example?replicaSet=rs0" TOKEN_SECRET=dev-token-secret TOKEN_ISSUER=terreno-dev REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET=dev-refresh-secret SESSION_SECRET=dev-session-secret PORT=4000 bun run backend:dev

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Terreno example universal app (Expo web) on http://localhost:8082, pointed at the local backend.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000 bun run frontend:web
